Would you like to work for a dynamic, high growth startup using cutting-edge machine learning tools and AI with the aim of protecting people in their daily work? At WorkVis.io we are now looking for an AI Engineer to join our team in Stockholm!


About the role

As AI Engineer you will select, develop, train, and deploy deep neural network architectures using tools such as PyTorch, and train them for object and event detection and classification tasks. You will also develop image analysis algorithms and deep learning architectures to solve problems. Your work will have a direct impact on workers saftey in some of the world’s most demanding industrial environments. You will be part of a collaborative and passionate team, with a shared mission - making workspaces safer.


To thrive in this role we believe you have:

  • A bachelor's degree or higher in machine learning, computer vision, computer science, mathematics or equivalent
  • 2+ years proven work experience in deep learning and machine learning
  • Passion and interest in working in a fast-paced startup & small-team environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • A willingness and ability to innovate and think "outside of the box"
  • Proficiency in developing deep learning architectures and image analysis algorithms
  • Python programming skills


Bonus points if you have C++ programming skills and familiarity with Linux, AWS, OpenCV, Git, Jira and Confluence.


About us

WorkVis.io is transforming workplace safety with video analytics and AI. Our mission is to increase workplace safety, productivity, and worker well-being while reducing the cost of compliance. With a combined 40+ years of experience in deploying innovative industrial safety solutions, the team is passionate about the role of technology in positively transforming workplaces to be safer and more productive. We are experts at using AI in safety systems and driven to improve workplace safety.


Our HQ is in Pittsburgh, PA, USA, and we also have an office in Kungsgatan, Stockholm.


Other information about this position

WorkVis is an equal opportunity employer, we strive to hire people with different backgrounds and experiences. As a part of this recruitment process we will perform a background check and a drug test.


This is a full-time position based in Stockholm. We will review applications on an ongoing basis, so submit your application today!


We look forward to hearing from you!
